definition: SameContext requires equality of law AND equality of the full stipulated input; Alternative h asks for a history k meeting these equalities with action h different from action k. It does not merely ask whether some other history has a different output. Deterministic response excludes Alternative without inserting equality of outputs into SameContext.
note: Analyst-defined control motivated by the Carneades definition fork; no source attribution. Adequacy and applicability remain open. See docs/notes/carneades-choice-context.md.
